headline: QA-focused signals: mobile automation release, AI-assisted triage advances, agent auditability, adaptive testing methods, and CI runner changes

top_signal.title: Maestro mobile automation: CLI v2.11.0 release
top_signal.summary: Maestro published CLI 2.11.0 / v2.11.0 (release tag cli-2.11.0 on Sep 29, 2026). Mobile QA teams should review the changelog for breaking changes, script behavior and device-support notes before updating runners.
top_signal.why_it_matters: Maestro upgrades can change test execution on device farms and CI runners — review before rolling out to avoid test-flakiness or infra breakage.

items.title: Seer Agent upgrades: write actions and infrastructure connectors for faster triage
items.summary: Sentry’s Seer Agent now performs write actions in Sentry (create monitors, assign/resolve issues) and can ingest Datadog and GCP data via Seer Connectors to improve diagnosis. Published Sept 29, 2026.
items.why_it_matters: Agents that act and pull infra telemetry speed triage but raise permission, audit and reproducibility questions for QA workflows and test-failure automation.

items.title: Cloudflare’s adaptive WAF tester: AI-driven, feedback-loop testing for detection gaps
items.summary: Cloudflare built an adaptive tester that varies inputs based on WAF responses and ran it across six attack categories to discover gaps a fixed test suite missed. Published Sept 29, 2026.
items.why_it_matters: Adaptive test loops catch evasive or variant-driven failures that static suites miss — useful pattern for QA tests of detectors, validators, and security rules.

items.title: Audit trails for autonomous agents with AWS DevOps Agent
items.summary: AWS details patterns for durable audit trails for autonomous DevOps agents: journaling decisions, recording actions, and linking evidence to change events. Published Sept 28, 2026.
items.why_it_matters: Traceable agent actions are essential for test reproducibility, root-cause analysis, and safe adoption of agentic test/execution tooling in production.

items.title: GitHub moves self-hosted runner version enforcement date
items.summary: GitHub changed enforcement timing for minimum self-hosted runner versions (announcement published Sept 28, 2026). Self-hosted runner upgrades may be required sooner or on revised schedule.
items.why_it_matters: Runner version enforcement can break test pipelines or change runner behavior; QA teams must inventory runners and plan upgrades to keep test CI green.

items.title: Kiro CLI as a pre-commit/git-hook agent to catch issues earlier
items.summary: AWS DevOps blog demonstrates using Kiro CLI as a pre-commit and git-hook agent to run checks and catch issues before commits leave developer machines. Published Sept 29, 2026.
items.why_it_matters: Shifting checks left reduces noisy test runs in CI and speeds feedback loops; QA should evaluate which tests are safe and fast enough to run pre-commit.

watch.title: Repository custom runner settings for Dependabot
watch.summary: GitHub added settings to choose runner type, optional custom labels and runner groups for Dependabot dependency and security update PRs. Published Sept 29, 2026.
watch.why_it_matters: This can change where and how dependency PRs run tests — important for preserving test coverage, avoiding noisy failures, and isolating privileged runner usage.

learning.title: Software Quality Assurance Tools and Tips for Developers (JetBrains Qodana)
learning.summary: JetBrains Qodana outlines practical QA tooling and processes to embed quality earlier in development: linters, static analysis, continuous checks, and integrating QA into delivery pipelines. Published Sept 29, 2026.
learning.why_it_matters: Concise checklist for teams improving testability and automating early-quality gates — useful reference for QA leads designing toolchains and shift-left strategies.
